email.subject: One quick confirmation and you're on the list
email.preview: Confirm your email and we'll take it from here.
email.greeting: Welcome — I'm glad you found us.
email.body: Getting your TIE in Barcelona shouldn't feel like a maze. Confirm your email below and we'll let you know the moment VisaMesa is ready to walk you through it, one step at a time.

email.footer: If this wasn't you, no action needed. Just ignore this email and nothing happens.
